title: Rhetoric and public speaking
learning_outcomes: Explain rhetorical appeals in the context of rhetoric and public speaking.
Compare and distinguish speech structure in the context of rhetoric and public speaking.
Apply misleading persuasion in the context of rhetoric and public speaking.
Evaluate and justify decisions about delivery in the context of rhetoric and public speaking.

lessons.title: Rhetorical appeals
lessons.outcome: Explain rhetorical appeals in the context of rhetoric and public speaking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving rhetorical appeals; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to evidence-based speech.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain rhetorical appeals from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of rhetorical appeals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Speech structure
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish speech structure in the context of rhetoric and public speaking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving speech structure; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to evidence-based speech.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain speech structure from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of speech structure; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Misleading persuasion
lessons.outcome: Apply misleading persuasion in the context of rhetoric and public speaking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving misleading persuasion; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to evidence-based speech.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain misleading persuasion from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of misleading persuasion; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Delivery
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about delivery in the context of rhetoric and public speaking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving delivery; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to evidence-based speech.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain delivery from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of delivery; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of rhetorical appeals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of speech structure; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of misleading persuasion; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of delivery; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Communication instructor; language instructor as needed.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
